title: Kīlauea Volcano — Pāhoehoe Flows on Kaupili Street
place: Kaupili Street, Leilani Estates subdivision, Kīlauea lower East Rift Zone, Hawaiʻi
audio: natural (kept AAC) - not listened to closely
notes: 'Video 2' of the page: daytime, lava ~2 m thick has oozed over a berm onto the asphalt road. Source frame is pillarboxed: picture occupies x~0.08-0.92 (black bars at sides). Grey pahoehoe pile with glowing red cracks across the frame (x~0.1-0.9,y~0.35-0.85), black asphalt-smoke rising at left (x~0.25,y~0.4), road edge bottom (y~0.9). At right (x~0.75-0.85,y~0.5) roadside bushes ignite with orange flames 0-13 s; glowing toes break out at the bottom left (x~0.2,y~0.8). Small USGS bug bottom-left (x~0.09-0.15,y~0.96) - crop away. Best shot A 0.0-2.6 (smoking lava pile at the road); shot B 6.0-8.6 (flames at right, breakouts). Recommended crop centre x~0.6.
fact_en: Burning asphalt created the black smoke seen in the video as the lava flow advanced down the street.
